title: Frictional work and entropy production in integrable and non-integrable spin chains
summary: The maximum work extractable from a quantum system is achieved when the system is driven adiabatically. Frictional work $\langle W\rangle_\mathrm{fric}$ then quantifies the difference in work output between adiabatic and non-adiabatic driving. Here we show that frictional work in a non-integrable spin chain is well-characterized by the diagonal entropy production $ΔS_\mathrm{d}$ associated with the build up of quantum coherence.
